newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch brewer Grolsch raises first half profits.
newsitem.headline: Dutch brewer Grolsch raises first half profits.

text.p: Dutch brewer Grolsch NV posted an 11 percent rise in first half profits on Wednesday and said it expected full-year profits to be higher than in 1995.
First half net came in at 21.0 million guilders ($12.61 million) versus a previous 18.9 million guilders, giving net per share of 1.32 guilders versus 1.16 guilders in the 1995 first half.
Six-month turnover increased to 319.9 million guilders from a previous 260.1 million guilders, with operating profit up to 35.5 million guilders from 29.5 million.
The profit figure was bang in line with analysts' forecasts of between 19.8 million guilders and 22.5 million guilders.
"On balance we expect another profit rise for the full year in line with our earlier forecasts," the brewer said.
Grolsch said in March it expected a further profit rise in 1996. Net profits in 1995 rose by 12 percent to 58.8 million guilders.
